what: On Apple on-device: Create World → Start a new game → idea words (no name) → Write the world; wait for the 7 cards (or an error); read the draft usage line

actions.type: A salt-marsh town where the tide clock is wound by whoever wakes first.

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){if(document.querySelectorAll('[data-card]').length===7){return {worldMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0};} const e=document.body.innerText.match(/Error · [\w.-]+/); if(e) return {error:e[0], ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'timeout';})()
